human_title: SYNTHETIC: A nozzle fan read 0 while its nozzle was at 60 degC or more, 4 samples in a row
limits: The 60 degC threshold and the sample count come from one multi-colour print on one U1 (about 18 000 samples, no fan at 0 above 45 degC); they are not official values.
Samples are about 60 s apart: a short real fault can be missed and a short normal pause can look like a fault.
A reading is a fact about reported values, not proof of a fault.
missing_data: Whether the fan was really stopped (no rpm collected) and whether a heater or fan fault code was shown.
safe_actions: Check on the printer itself whether that nozzle fan spins; do not keep a hot nozzle idle without cooling.
Follow the official procedure for any displayed code.
